description: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited develops a direct-to-customer digital investment platform that provides wealth creation opportunities through multiple financial products and services in India. Its platform Groww, allows users to invest in and trade stocks, including cash, intraday, and IPO; equity and commodity derivatives; bonds; mutual funds; margin trading facility; exchange traded funds; personal loans, loan against securities; and other products. The company also offers Groww Lite, a secure, lightweight, web-based trading platform accessible on both desktop and mobile browsers; as well as Groww Charts, a mobile charting platform that helps users trade smarter. In addition, it provides content, such as financial literacy resources, news, and information through Groww Digest, blogs and newsletters. Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited was founded in 2016 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
